newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks seen opening higher on momentum.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks seen opening higher on momentum.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were seen opening higher on Wednesday, helped by momentum from Tuesday's late surge and record close.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average overcame steep losses and powered the index to its second straight record close, at 6601. The Nasdaq Composite also set a new record, rising 11 points to close at 1328.
Analysts said the markets were unlikely to be affected by November consumer credit data out at 2000 GMT. The consensus was for $5.5 billion, against October's $2.2 billion.
